heading_path: Part 13—Importation of goods infringing Australian trade marks
text: In this Part, a reference to the Comptroller-General of Customs includes a reference to: (b) for Christmas Island—the Comptroller as defined in the Customs Act 1901 of Christmas Island; and (c) for the Cocos (Keeling) Islands—the Comptroller as defined in the Customs Act 1901 of the Cocos (Keeling) Islands.
title: Definition

units.text: In this Part, a reference to the Comptroller-General of Customs includes a reference to:
(b) for Christmas Island—the Comptroller as defined in the Customs Act 1901 of Christmas Island; and
(c) for the Cocos (Keeling) Islands—the Comptroller as defined in the Customs Act 1901 of the Cocos (Keeling) Islands.
